title: Financial Consultant vs Accountant vs Auditor in Nepal (Key Differences)
metaDescription: Understand the differences between a financial consultant, accountant, and statutory auditor in Nepal. Learn which professional your business requires and when.
h1: Financial Consultant vs Accountant vs Auditor: Key Differences
directAnswer: The fundamental difference lies in their operational scope and regulatory function: an accountant records daily commercial transactions (past/present); a financial consultant designs budgets, forecasts, and capital strategies (future); and an auditor independently examines closed annual accounts under the Nepal Chartered Accountants Act 2053 to certify statutory compliance for shareholders, the IRD, and the OCR.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.contentHtml:
Selecting the wrong professional for a specific task leads to wasted capital or legal non-compliance. Here is how each role operates in a Nepalese company:

The Accountant

Focus: Historical Accuracy

Responsible for issuing VAT bills, recording journal vouchers, maintaining bank registers, and producing internal trial balances.

The Financial Consultant

Focus: Strategic Forward-Look

Analyzes ledger data to project 6-month cash runway, model product pricing, calculate working capital ratios, and negotiate bank credit facilities.

The Statutory Auditor

Focus: Legal Assurance

External ICAN member conducting independent audit sampling to verify that accounts provide a true and fair view in compliance with NFRS.

sections.h2: Legal Restrictions on Professional Independence in Nepal
sections.contentHtml: Under ICAN Code of Ethics and Companies Act 2063, a statutory auditor cannot maintain a company's internal accounts or provide management decision consulting to an entity they audit. This independence rule protects shareholders and the public. Our practice focuses purely on strategic financial consulting and accounting preparation, collaborating seamlessly with independent audit firms.

faqs.question: Can our external auditor also prepare our cash flow forecasts?
faqs.answer: While an auditor can review forecasts for a loan application, performing ongoing management consulting creates conflict-of-interest risks under ICAN independence guidelines.
